node_notes.dht_service: This box defines the service-level DHT22 processing API that consumes a dht22_port_t and produces a dht22_sample_t. firmware/services/dht22_service.h provides the contract, but the supplied files do not show a runtime caller or implementation.
node_notes.main_entry: This box is the ESP-IDF entry shim that exposes app_main and delegates immediately to app_start. The evidence is main/entry.c lines 4-8, including the app_start call.
node_notes.app_owner: This box owns the implemented application startup behavior and emits the firmware-started message. firmware/app/app.c lines 8-10 define app_start and call ESP_LOGI through logger.h.
node_notes.mpu_io: This box is the callback-based register transport required by the MPU6050 driver. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu_6000_mpu_6050/mpu6050.h defines mpu6050_io_t with read, write, and delay_ms callbacks and leaves the physical bus to the integrator.
node_notes.logger_api: This is the only evidenced runtime sink: the application uses ESP_LOGI through the logger wrapper. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h re-exports esp_log.h, and app.c supplies the startup message.
node_notes.dht_port: This box is the vendor-agnostic DHT22 I/O contract carrying data_gpio, read_frame, and delay_ms callbacks. firmware/interfaces/dht22_port.h defines dht22_port_t and its GPIO-bearing interface.
node_notes.mpu_driver: This box is the portable MPU6050 register driver and its sample, power, FIFO, and interrupt operations. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu_6000_mpu_6050/mpu6050.c implements the API, but no platform bus or application binding is supplied.
node_notes.dht22: This box represents the configured DHT22 data connection on GPIO 2. The pin is stated in the diagram brief and APP_DHT22_DATA_GPIO is defined as 2 in firmware/configs/app_config.h.
node_notes.app_config: This configuration box supplies the DHT22 GPIO value and sampling constants. firmware/configs/app_config.h defines APP_DHT22_DATA_GPIO as 2, along with the two-second sample period and retry limit.

lld.mermaid:
flowchart TD subgraph startup_flow["One-shot startup"] boot["ESP-IDF invokes entry point
main/entry.c:5"] call_app["Call application startup
main/entry.c:7"] start_app["Emit firmware startup log
firmware/app/app.c:8-10"] boot -->|app_main| call_app call_app -->|app_start| start_app end

node_notes.start_app: This step logs the literal firmware-started status and then returns. firmware/app/app.c lines 8-10 implement app_start with ESP_LOGI, so no sensor sampling or task execution is evidenced in the runtime flow.
node_notes.call_app: This step performs the only startup delegation shown in the sources. main/entry.c calls app_start without creating a task or starting a periodic loop.
node_notes.boot: This step represents the ESP-IDF reset path entering the generated application shim. main/entry.c defines app_main as the firmware entry function.
